Name: Think-n-Talk
Author: klatuprism
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Think-n-Talk[/size][/b][/center][center][i]by Prism99[/i][/center]

Now you can think and talk, in game, and those thoughts and words are visible to other Players in a multiplayer game.  The mod is compatible with the more powerful Think-n-Talk available in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8715]Stardew Web[/url].   This version does not require Stardew Web, but does not have the ability to record thoughts and words.


[list]
[*]type '/think text' into the chat box and the think bubble will appear above your Farmer.
[*]type '/talk text' into the chat box and the talk bubble will appear above your Farmer.
[*]type '/clear' or '/talk' or '/think' to remove your thought or talk box.
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.4 on Windows.  There is also a beta version for the SDV 1.5.5 beta version.   Single and multiplayer (players without the mod will not see the think or thought bubbles).  I have not tested it on other platforms.

[size=5]Customization[/size]
The think and talk bubbles are png image files stored in the Think-n-Talk\assets\bubbleguy directory. You can add your own creations by placing a png named 'custom_think_bubble.png' for think bubble or 'custom_talk_bubble.png' for the talk bubble. In multiplayer games your custom images will be sent to the other players so they will see your custom bubbles.

If you has some custom bubbles of your own and wish to share them, consider uploading your bubble files to the Images section of this mod page.

[size=5]Source Code:[/size]
Available at [url=https://github.com/Prism-99/Think-n-Talk]github[/url]
